messages:
Priya: Heads-up — surfaced a pattern in prod traces: a small subset of older SDKs are dropping our new v2 header `X-Redwood-API-Version` and failing auth. Not widespread but consistent for ~5k requests over the last 6h.
Sam: Thanks Priya. Do we know which SDK versions?
Priya: Looks like node-sdk <= 0.9.1 and mobile-sdk 1.2.x. Trace IDs: rfc:abc123.. if you want to poke.
Lina: If old SDKs are missing the header we should support a graceful fallback in the proxy. We already look for `Authorization` but not an alt header. Suggest `X-Redwood-Compat` as a temporary fallback to accept requests while we nudge clients.
Raj: +1 for a proxy fallback but we need a strict canary and metric so we don't silently accept malformed clients forever.
Jo: Agreed. Proposal: 1) proxy accepts `X-Redwood-Compat` only from canary slice for 48h; 2) emit metric `compat_header_fallback` with labels (sdk, version, region); 3) alert if rate > 1% of traffic.
Sam: That seems reasonable. Does anyone object to the header name? We should avoid colliding with user headers. Maybe `X-Redwood-API-Version-Fallback` ?
Priya: I'd prefer shorter but explicit. `X-Redwood-Compat` is fine if documented in the rollout note. We must also ensure Dedicated/Private customers are opt-in.
Lina: Implementation details for the proxy (nginx envoy layer): quick sketch — in envoy Lua filter do: 
```
local v = request:headers():get('x-redwood-api-version')
if not v then
  local alt = request:headers():get('x-redwood-compat')
  if alt then request:headers():add('x-redwood-api-version', alt) end
end
```
and emit a counter.
Raj: Can we instead rewrite at the ingress router (go proxy) to keep metrics consistent? Envoy Lua is fine for a fast patch but long-term should be in go-proxy.
Jo: We'll do a two-step: quick Envoy patch (low-risk) + follow-up go-proxy PR within 5 working days. Also add a feature flag `enable_compat_fallback` controlled by rollout service.
Sam: Who owns the quick patch? I can take Envoy change and smoke it in staging today. Who reviews?
Priya: Sam you + Lina for review. Raj can own the go-proxy follow-up. I'll own communication to SDK team and CS.
Sam: Pushed a draft patch to staging: `git sha: b7c2f8c`. Deploy-bot: canary deploy queued.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for ingress-envoy (sha b7c2f8c) — slices: canary-2, expected rollout: 10m.
Lina: Testing notes: I hit staging with a curl that omits header and sets `X-Redwood-Compat: "2024-07-01"`. Works, metric emitted. Example curl: 
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' -H 'X-Redwood-Compat: 2024-07-01' https://staging.api.redwood.ai/generate
```
Jo: Great. Priya please add a short deprecation note that clients must send `X-Redwood-API-Version: v2` by 2024-09-30, otherwise rate-limited. Also add an SDK PR checklist link for owners.
Priya: Will do. I'll post an async update in `eng-platform` and ping SDK owners. Also scheduling a 15m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT for any blockers.
Raj: For tracking: created internal ticket RW-4567 (deps: sdk-team, infra-proxy). Assignments: Envoy patch -> Sam, Envoy review -> Lina, Go-proxy follow-up -> Raj.
Sam: Quick question — do we need an SDK hotfix for mobile 1.2.x to add header automatically?
Priya: Yes we'll ask SDK team for a micro-release that sets the header by default; but plan for some clients to not upgrade so fallback remains necessary for the window.
Lina: After 48h canary, if metrics stable (<0.2% fallback) we expand to 10% slice, then full.
Jo: I'll add the rollout steps to the runbook and the rollback criteria (`compat_header_fallback` spike > 2% -> rollback).
Priya: Awesome. Thanks all. I'll follow up with the SDK ownership ping and post the staging smoke results here.
Sam: Smoke green so far, will monitor logs for next hour.
Priya: last: CC @sdk-team @support for visibility (posting now).
